nodes.label: shadcn/ui
nodes.rationale: Copy-in-source registry model: components are added to the codebase via CLI rather than installed as a dependency.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md
nodes.rationale: Plain-text visual spec handed to coding agents so generated UI follows one design system.

nodes.label: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
nodes.rationale: Common protocol that lets coding agents call design/context tools; many agents-mcp tools ship MCP servers.

nodes.label: Piece frame function (t, env) => string
nodes.rationale: Each piece is a dependency-free module exporting meta and a pure frame function; text pieces render into <pre>, coloured pieces onto <canvas>, so no runtime deps or video/canvas engine are needed.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion first-frame hold
nodes.rationale: Pieces play only while on screen and hold their first frame for users preferring reduced motion; set motion:true only behind a user control.

nodes.label: Design tokens
nodes.rationale: Playbook rule: lock tokens before picking components.

nodes.label: Work order: write TolongDesign tool docs
nodes.norm_label: work order: write tolongdesign tool docs

nodes.label: Atmospheric 3D character scene
nodes.source_url: Combine an existing character and animation clips with an agent-built environment, effects, and controls; refine the scene across multiple prompt rounds.

nodes.label: Build with an agent
nodes.source_url: Give the agent the brief, tokens, and paths to the selected tools, then use the linked agent and polish references.

nodes.label: Collect references
nodes.source_url: Gather 8–15 screenshots or links that agree on a direction, then write a brief with audience, tone, reference sites, and things to avoid.

nodes.label: Default design stack
nodes.source_url: Start with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, free or freemium tools, and the listed defaults unless the brief says otherwise; paid picks need client approval.

nodes.label: Choose icons, imagery, motion, and 3D
nodes.source_url: Choose visual assets and motion tools by their role in the page, and respect reduced-motion preferences.

nodes.label: Lock the visual system
nodes.source_url: Set type, color, spacing, radius, and shadow decisions before component selection, and record reusable values as tokens.

nodes.label: One change per prompt round
nodes.source_url: Adjust one category at a time—character, motion, lighting, then details—to make iteration more controlled.

nodes.label: Pick components
nodes.source_url: Choose primitives, marketing blocks, showpiece components, and dashboard components to match the project.

nodes.label: Ship the website
nodes.source_url: Optimize images and SVGs, generate social preview images, deploy, and record a demo.

nodes.label: Use one or two showpiece components
nodes.norm_label: use one or two showpiece components
nodes.source_url: Limit animated or showpiece components to one or two per page.

nodes.label: Tokens before components
nodes.source_url: Choose typography, color, spacing, radius, and shadows as a shared visual system before selecting components, then store the values once as theme tokens or CSS variables.

nodes.label: Character animation retargeting
nodes.rationale: Retarget Mixamo FBX clips onto a VRM character to reuse believable motion without hand-keying the animation.

nodes.label: Copy and adapt a proven motion prompt
